description:
A safe home for all your data. Access & share your files, calendars, contacts, mail & more from any device, on your terms. This is the developer version of the official Nextcloud Android app.
* Do not install this version for your productive work!
* Intended for users willing to test new features and report bugs if they occur.
* Includes brand-new, untested features which might lead to instabilities and data loss.
* Can be installed alongside the official Nextcloud app (which is available at F-Droid, too).
* The main source code branch is checked once a day for changes.
* New builds are generated as needed (usually several times a week, but not necessarily daily).
Please report any problems discovered at https://github.com/nextcloud/android/issues
Thanks for testing ;-)
